cases.question: 按客户所在巴西州统计有效订单GMV
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT
    dc.state AS 客户州,
    SUM(foi.price) AS 成交总额
FROM fact_order_item foi
JOIN fact_order fo ON foi.order_id = fo.order_id
JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id
WHERE fo.status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY dc.state
ORDER BY 成交总额 DESC;
cases.validated_sql: SELECT dc.state AS 客户州, SUM(foi.price) AS 成交总额 FROM fact_order_item AS foi JOIN fact_order AS fo ON foi.order_id = fo.order_id JOIN dim_customer AS dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE NOT fo.status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY dc.state ORDER BY 成交总额 DESC LIMIT 500

cases.question: 按商品英文品类统计有效订单GMV

FROM fact_order_item oi
JOIN fact_order o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN dim_product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN dim_category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.category_name_en

cases.question: 对比2018年4月和5月已送达与已取消订单的数量
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(purchase_date, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, status AS 订单状态, COUNT(order_id) AS 订单数量
FROM fact_order
WHERE purchase_date >= '2018-04-01' AND purchase_date < '2018-06-01'
  AND status IN ('delivered', 'canceled')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(purchase_date, '%Y-%m'), status
ORDER BY 月份, 订单状态
